description: List topics with at least one currently available whole answer cell. Each object carries answerCount: distinct available questions in the requested locale, not variants, sources or articles. Limit is an upper bound: counted pages emit at most 4 objects and at most 64 candidate pairs. Follow nextCursor until null; total counts matching objects, not answers. Counts are observed in one read-only snapshot per page at countObservedAt; pages are not one shared snapshot. Invalid cursors or incomplete counts return an error, never partial or stale numbers. Availability does not establish current law or personal applicability.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor: the exact nextCursor returned by the previous call. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Requested upper bound; default 100, maximum 250. Counted pages return at most 4 objects and may be shorter to respect the 64 candidate-pair budget; follow nextCursor.

type.description: Filter by object type, e.g. state, program, regime, bank, legal_form.

name: answer_objects

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null on the last page.

answerCount.description: Distinct currently available whole question cells in this locale.

provenance.description: Origin of one record: stable id, clean canonical URL, publisher, the exact published revision served, a ready citation, primary sources and review status.

id.description: <locale>:<slug> for an article, <dataset>:<record id> for a dataset row.

version.description: Revision of exactly the material served: for an article the snapshot content hash (the HTML ETag value); for a dataset record the dataset revision it was published in, not the published filename. Null when unknown.

total.description: Every object matching the type filter, across all pages.

title: List reviewed native topics
